rows.note: This is the all-purpose everyday choice for a tooth cavity or tooth decay.

example.english: I have a cavity in my molar, and even cold food makes it hurt.
example.traditional: 我粒大牙有蛀牙，食凍嘢都會痛。
example.jyutping: ngo5 lap1 daai6 ngaa4 jau5 zyu3 ngaa4 sik6 dung3 je5 dou1 wui6 tung3

rows.note: Use this when focusing specifically on the hole in the tooth rather than the decay generally.

example.english: The dentist said I have a cavity in my tooth that needs filling.
example.traditional: 牙醫話我隻牙有個牙窿，要補返。
example.jyutping: ngaa4 ji1 waa6 ngo5 zek3 ngaa4 jau5 go3 ngaa4 lung1 jiu3 bou2 faan2

rows.note: Use this anatomical term for a hollow space inside the body, not for a tooth cavity.

example.english: This scan can show whether there is a cavity inside the body.
example.traditional: 呢種掃描可以睇到身體入面有冇空腔。
example.jyutping: ne1 zung2 sou3 miu4 ho2 ji5 tai2 dou3 san1 tai2 jap6 min6 jau5 mou5 hung1 hong1
